label: refill host slot before consumer release
hypothesis: Producer waits for previous GPU consumer release before refilling host storage, although host storage is safe as soon as previous DMA completes. Move release wait after fresh CPU gather to overlap it with ongoing consumption.
expected_bottleneck: CPU producer release waits serialize next gather unnecessarily
change: Reorder only pipeline pinned-host refill and consumer-release wait. Preserve copied.synchronize before host overwrite and consumed-event wait before device overwrite; no added buffers, table layout change or lookup cache.
tradeoffs: More CPU work may occur before cancellation is observed; retain cancellation checks and exact exception cleanup.
Overlap opportunity may be hidden by DMA/compute; require paired wall-time and gap confirmation.
decision: Exactness gates passed. Run predeclared twelve-job screen; no gain claim yet.
